failedDetails.description: Search engines are unable to include your pages in search results if they don't have permission to crawl them.

seo.contract: During unlisted-beta global noindex, every applicable SEO audit must PASS and is-crawlable must be the sole failed SEO audit (raw SEO score recorded, currently 60). When global noindex is retired, SEO must be 100 with no exception. No artificial noindex-stripped build may be used as production evidence.

note: Amended contract 2026-08-19 (issue #104#issuecomment-5351661545): Accessibility 100, Best Practices 100, Performance >=90, every applicable SEO audit PASS and is-crawlable sole failed (raw SEO 60 recorded with exact audit evidence). Future: SEO 100 with no exception once global noindex retired. Gate PASS per amended contract — is-crawlable is the sole failed applicable SEO audit; any second failure blocks. Raw JSON/HTML are CI artifacts at /tmp, not committed.
